newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-SHEARER GETS GO-AHEAD FOR NEWCASTLE COMEBACK.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-SHEARER GETS GO-AHEAD FOR NEWCASTLE COMEBACK.

text.p: Alan Shearer has been given the go-ahead to make his Newcastle comeback against Chelsea in Saturday's English premier league match.
The England captain and striker came through Thursday's training session with flying colours and will return to action at Stamford Bridge, just one month after his groin operation.
Newcastle spokesman Graham Courtney said: "Alan has trained today and he'll be okay to play on Saturday.
"He's not suffered any reaction. There's no soreness and he's as fit as a fiddle."

Shearer had his first full Newcastle training session on Tuesday morning after Newcastle manager Kevin Keegan had said the previous day that Shearer was on course for a comeback at Chelsea providing he suffered no setbacks in training.
Shearer's return is a timely one for the league leaders with strike partner Les Ferdinand several weeks away from a return to first-team action.
Fellow England international Ferdinand suffered a depressed cheekbone in last Saturday's home league draw with West Ham and is recovering from an operation which successfully repaired the damage.
